command.name: Gleaming Spiral
verbatim: Each Round: 25% chance to reduce the Fire Damage Dealt of all enemies that deal Fire Damage by -15% for 1 round(s).
Rounds 1, 2, 3, 5, 8: Deal Tactical Damage to all enemies that deal Physical Damage (excluding Basic Attacks) (Damage Rate: +45%).
At 6+ Stars: Rounds 1, 2, 3, 5, 8: Deal Physical Damage to 2 Enemies in any lane (Damage Rate: +28%). This damage is increased by 1.5x (+42%) on Round 5 and by 2x (+56%) on Round 8.

vanguard.name: Champion's Brilliance
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Strength, Intelligence, and Instinct by +15. Reduce Damage Received by -8% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Hypnotic Helix
verbatim: Rounds 1, 3, 6, 8: 25% chance to Overwhelm 1 Enemy in any lane for 2 round(s) (prioritize Fire Damage dealers).
Rounds 2, 4, 7, 9: 25% chance to Stagger 1 Enemy in any lane for 2 round(s) (prioritize Physical Damage dealers).

habits.name: Battle Cunning
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce Strength and Intelligence by -6% (enhanced by Instinct) of 3 Enemies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Spiral Surge
habits.verbatim: Rounds 1, 2, 3, 5, 8: Deal Physical Damage to 2 Enemies in any lane (Damage Rate: +28%). This damage is increased by 1.5x (+42%) on Round 5 and by 2x (+56%) on Round 8.

habits.name: Iron Shell
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce Physical Damage Received (excluding Basic Attacks) and Fire Damage Received of 2 other Allies in any lane by -2% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Mimicry
verbatim: Start of each Round: If any ally is afflicted with Weakened or Vulnerable, there is a 25% chance to apply that same effect to 1 Enemy in any lane for 2 round(s).
Start of each Round: If any enemy is enhanced by Advantage or Resistance, there is a 25% chance to apply that same effect to 1 Ally in any lane for 2 round(s).

formation_needs: Allies that can expose Weakened or Vulnerable for Mimicry
derived.notes: A flexible Vanguard controller that counters opposing damage types and protects the Right Flank.
